text:
maria-ops: Heads up — seeing a spike in SSO failures after the RBAC role rename. Users can't finish login, Okta shows 'authnContext missing'.

samir-idp: Yup, started ~12:02. 403 from /saml/acs for multiple accounts. Investigating.

idp-bot: Alert: SAML assertion validation failed count=58 window=5m

ava-sre: Logs snippet: `POST /saml/acs 403 224ms user=alice@example.com reason=InvalidAuthnContext authn_context='urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:ac:classes:unspecified'`

samir-idp: We rolled RBAC role names yesterday and kicked a SCIM job. Might be mapping mismatch — role mapper could be rejecting assertions if mapped role not found.

maria-ops: Also seeing KMS errors in the audit pipeline around the same time: `audit-writer: decrypt: tag mismatch` when trying to sign SSO events.

devex-quentin: Is audit-writer pointed at the new alias? We rotated the KMS alias during the rename deploy.

samir-idp: quick check: env shows `SSO_KMS_KEY_ALIAS=sso-v2` but service config expects `sso-v1`. That explains audit failures but shouldn't block the ACS response path.

ava-sre: Stackflow: Okta -> idp-proxy -> ACS handler -> role-mapper -> SCIM update. Traces show role-mapper threw on missing groups, bubble up ended as 403/InvalidAuthnContext.

maria-ops: Hypothesis: empty `groups` attribute after rename causes mapper NPE -> 500 -> we translate to 403. SCIM sync probably removed/renamed group entries.

samir-idp: Patching role-mapper to guard on missing/empty groups and fallback to default-role. Deploying canary now.

idp-bot: Deploy started: canary idp-role-mapper v2.1.1 by @samir-idp

ava-sre: Canary looks good: 10/10 logins passed in canary region over 3m. No regressions in latency.

maria-ops: Rolling to prod in 2m. Workaround for support: ask Okta to set `includeGroups=true` for affected apps until we finish rollout. @partners-okta

samir-idp: Okta team says they can toggle includeGroups, but we should also add explicit authnContext fallback and unit tests. Opening PR now.

maria-ops: Also include KMS rotation mismatch in the incident ticket — remediation: verify key alias for audit-writer and rollback or re-encrypt audit backlog if needed. Possible regression from simultaneous rotate+rename deploy.

devex-quentin: :thumbsup: I'll update the SSO runbook and add a postmortem checklist item about coordinating KMS rotations with role changes.

maria-ops: Thanks all — monitoring for errors to drop. Will update incident thread with timeline and postmortem items.
